$comment: Decided by INO-173: the sub-scale values below (1px/2px/6px/10px/48px spacing, 2px
radius) are optical/local geometry — hairline border pulls, icon-button outdents,
micro gaps between an icon and its label, grid-hairline tricks, badge/pill padding,
and one-off component chrome — not steps on the shared spacing/radius rhythm.
Same call the lint already makes for `top`/`left` (see check-ds-adherence.mjs's
SPACE_PROPS comment) and the same call tokens.css itself makes at --ino-control-gap-default
('6px would be a new primitive for a 2px win'): a value used by exactly one component's
local geometry — even if a sibling screen happens to reuse the same number — does not
clear the bar for a new scale step the way a role consumed system-wide does (doc 16 §4.3).
No new --ino-space-*/--ino-radius-* primitive was added; tokens.css stays frozen post-Wave 0.
This is NOT a ratchet like ds-adherence-waivers.json: it is not pending cleanup and has
no 'the issue that will delete it'. An entry here is a standing design decision. Removing
one means the value has genuinely become a rhythm value (reused as a role elsewhere) and
should move to tokens.css via a Wave 0 amendment instead.
Unused entries still fail the build, same as waivers — if a component is later restyled
onto the scale, delete its entry rather than leaving a dead allowance.
